title: How Romantic Are You?
description: Discover your romantic personality type! Answer 12 questions to find out just how romantic you truly are.

options.text: Plan an elaborate surprise with flowers, dinner, and thoughtful gifts
Enjoy a nice dinner out but keep it simple
Acknowledge it but don't make a big deal
It's just another day to me

questions.text: When you have a crush, you...

options.text: Can't stop thinking about them and daydream constantly
Think about them often but stay practical
Take it slow and see how things go
Focus on whether they're interested first
A candlelit dinner under the stars with soft music
A fun activity together like mini-golf or bowling
Coffee or a casual meal to talk
Whatever works with both schedules

questions.text: When in love, you tend to...

options.text: Write love letters, plan surprises, and say 'I love you' often
Show affection through actions and quality time
Express love in practical ways like helping with tasks
Focus on building a stable future together

results.title: The Hopeless Romantic
results.description: Love is everything to you! You believe in fairy-tale endings, grand gestures, and sweeping people off their feet. Your heart leads the way, and you're not afraid to wear it on your sleeve. For you, love is the most beautiful thing in life.

results.title: The Sweet Dreamer
results.description: You have a romantic heart but keep it balanced with reality. You love thoughtful gestures and meaningful moments, but you also appreciate the practical side of relationships. You're the type to plan nice dates while staying grounded.

results.title: The Practical Romantic
results.description: You show love through actions rather than grand gestures. While you appreciate romance, you believe it should fit naturally into everyday life. Your love is steady, reliable, and deep - just not overly dramatic.

results.title: The Logical Lover
results.description: Romance isn't your strong suit, but that doesn't mean you don't love deeply. You approach relationships with a analytical mind, focusing on compatibility and long-term potential. Your affection shows in steady support rather than passionate gestures.
